frozen: 2026-10-09, before any Phase 5 judgment or context metric was computed
unit: repository: every task of a repository is in one split
rule: fixture/py_repo -> dev; ContextBench repositories sorted by sha256('oxide-decisionbench-v1/' + repo), each assigned to the split furthest below its target share of tasks (dev 0.3, calibration 0.3, test 0.4; ties dev < calibration < test)

splits.dev: evaluation design and development; metrics may be read freely
splits.calibration: held-out calibration: fit/threshold confidence only here, never on test
splits.test: final repository-held-out test: sealed until a preregistered comparison runs
splits.train_reserved: reserved for future training; empty in v1 (no training in Phase 5)
